EventEmitter

Defined in: events.ts:9

@antv/g6-gl A high-performance graph analysis engine based on WebGL, designed for large-scale graph data analysis.

Public API surface is being re-baselined during the 0.1.0 beta period. Engine internals are excluded from the package root and published API declarations; consume supported APIs only through this entry point.

runLayout()

Defined in: layout/runLayout.ts:69

Run the configured layout on graph data; returns nodes with positions. Layout options are passed through to the underlying @antv/layout algorithm. When config.worker is true (or auto-detected for large graphs), layout runs in a Web Worker to avoid blocking the main thread. Falls back to main-thread layout if the Worker fails.
